**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
An approach to constructing system models directly from fundamental physical or mathematical laws, without relying on empirical fitting parameters or ad-hoc assumptions. This is critical for neuromorphic engineering in iNEST, as it allows for the design of neural-inspired hardware with predictable and robust dynamics derived from underlying physics.
